# Morrow Works — fictional company

Morrow Works

We design modular objects for calmer desks. This company, its people, products and policies are authored fiction for the Intakelet demo.

Made for small workspaces

Our sample range contains Loop Stand and Desk Tray. Both use replaceable components.

# Products — Morrow Works fixture

Products

Loop Stand

Loop Stand is a fictional adjustable stand for small notebooks. Its modular joints can be replaced separately.

Desk Tray

Desk Tray is a fictional shallow organizer with three removable dividers. It belongs to the same authored sample range.
